sources.title: Flux 3 — Black Forest Labs' Multimodal AI for Images, Video & Audio
sources.snippet: Flux 3 is the latest frontier model from Black Forest Labs, the company founded by the original creators of Stable Diffusion. Unlike earlier FLUX models that focused on still images, Flux 3 jointly generates images, video, and audio within a single unified architecture, and extends to action prediction for embodied AI use cases.
